object_description: large triangular pancake beneath a shed roof
design_condition: The equilateral triangular volume is aligned with the hospital extension, Route d'Hérens and the eastern park, but its finite geometry raises questions about its proximity to the road and its fit within the site.

positive.statement: The radical principle of interior spatial organization caught the jury's attention.
The streets, alleys, squares and small squares create an attractive interior world.

negative.statement: The roads and houses are more restrictive than they initially appear and offer little flexibility.
The triangular shape makes it difficult to inscribe the program, with oblique encounters questioning the formal premise.
The triangular shape does not convince in its integration into the site or its capacity to accommodate the program.
The project does not take sustainable-development principles into account.
The volume is larger than average and has a very high form factor.
Embodied energy consumption would be very high because of the non-compact project, heavily glazed facades and glass-and-steel roof.
